hits.title: How Speech Analytics is Transforming the Insurance Industry?
hits.snippet:
## The Bottom Line

Insurance companies that treat every customer conversation as a source of valuable intelligence will outperform those that let those conversations disappear into silence. Using speech analytics across contact centers transforms voice calls and phone calls from fleeting moments into actionable data that drives customer experience improvements, strengthens compliance, and boosts agent performance. [...] In insurance specifically, speech analytics tools are applied to claims calls, underwriting conversations, renewal discussions, complaint handling, and compliance-sensitive customer interactions. Whether a policyholder is reporting a fender bender or a claims adjuster is walking through a complex liability case, the technology captures and performs speech analysis on what is said, how it is said, and what it means for the business. This covers both the content of customer calls and the vocal [...] Speech analytics processes spoken customer conversations from voice calls and phone calls, using speech recognition to analyze human speech and detect vocal cues like tone, stress, and pace to gauge customer sentiment. Text analytics analyzes written interactions such as emails, chats, and surveys using keyword and sentiment analysis. hits.title: Insurance Customer Experience: Strategies for Success | Talkdesk
hits.snippet:
Insurance customer experience (CX) refers to the journey a policyholder has with an insurance provider, from initial research and quote comparison, through onboarding and policy management, to claims processing and renewal. It covers every interaction, whether it happens online, over the phone, through an agent, or via a mobile app. [...] Insurance customer experience (CX) refers to the journey a customer has with an insurance provider, from researching policies and purchasing coverage to managing claims and renewals. It includes every interaction across digital and human touchpoints, and reflects how seamless, transparent, and personalized those experiences feel.

### Why is customer experience important in insurance? [...] To support ongoing development, many insurers are turning to workforce engagement management (WEM) solutions. These platforms use data and analytics to monitor performance, identify coaching opportunities, and personalize training for each agent. Some even use AI to surface best-practice responses and real-time suggestions during live conversations.
